accountable_decision_owner: Cole Lyons, USHSO Public Alpha methodology owner
active_family_basis: No source enumerates dedicated emergency departments by the frozen product-system boundary and common period; hospital membership, facility Emergency Services flags, flag sums, campus inference, facility aggregation, missing-as-no, imputation, and fabricated zeroes are prohibited.
active_family_definition: Count of distinct dedicated emergency departments under 42 CFR 489.24(b), including qualifying on-campus and off-campus departments or facilities, within one approved current product-system roster and common period.
comparison_period_rule: No common period or lag window is approved; AHRQ 2023 membership, CMS April 2026 facility flags, and the 2026-07-16 regulatory definition cannot be combined into system-level counts.
comparison_purpose: Determine whether emergency_department_count can be appended to the common nine-input Scale v1 packet without weakening the frozen roster, period, dedicated-department definition, campus taxonomy, crosswalk, or organizational-boundary gates.
